scope: Backend-only synthetic diagnostic reproductions; no application fixes
database: Local disposable PostgreSQL 15 container, separate audit_<uuid> schema per probe
limitations: These are targeted service/ORM probes, not a complete HTTP end-to-end run or provider certification.
Native probes used model-created tables; migrated constraints are separately exercised by the existing migration test.
The payout probe invoked the legacy route function with a synthetic admin identity, not through HTTP authentication.
The multi-brand fixture directly created its second seller order; settlement and allocation used real service code.
An initial diagnostic harness failed by reading an expired ORM ID after rollback; the corrected probe captured scalar IDs before rollback. This was not recorded as an application defect.
Probe scripts were diagnostic invocations, not newly committed regression tests. Each finding still requires a regression test in its repair batch.

observations.scenario: Withdraw 500 from 1000 available, reject, then complete through the legacy route with a supplied reference
observations.invariant_violated: A rejected payout cannot become completed without a valid approved transition and receipt

observations.scenario: Inject failure immediately after PaymentService.refund commits and before the return caller links it; roll back caller
observations.invariant_violated: Return-linked refund creation must be atomic

observations.scenario: Reverse 1020 from a pending balance of 2040
observations.invariant_violated: Wallet audit balance must match the actual post-transaction balance

observations.scenario: Complete a partial refund, age the settlement ledger ten days and run the release worker
observations.invariant_violated: A completed partial refund must not permanently freeze the legitimate remaining entitlement

observations.scenario: Two 2400 seller orders; confirm brand A's 1200 return, then settle brand B
observations.invariant_violated: A seller-specific return must not reduce an unrelated seller's settlement

cleanup: Each probe disposed its engines and removed only its validated disposable schema in finally blocks. No development/production database or external provider was used.
